terms.gloss: in short, in a word, on the whole
evidence: Cic. Att. 14.1.1: ad summam: nōn posse istaec sīc abīre (Lewis & Short)
Quint. 4.2.90: quaedam partibus blandiuntur, sed in summam nōn cōnsentiunt (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Of the whole set against its parts.

sources: Lewis & Short: summa
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
